plan.title: Forward auction rejects start price above end price

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation flow.
Ensure vendors can be added during event creation as required by the case.
Set the event type to Auction before configuring the forward auction.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.

args.goal: Select the forward/sell auction template, set the auction start price to 200 and end price to 100, and stop with those values visible on the auction configuration screen

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for selecting a forward auction template or entering its start and end prices.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Set the first row's delivery location to the required plant.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields before publishing.
Add the two vendors named in the case.
Commit the required Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Attempt to publish the auction with start price 200 and end price 100.
